none_means: No qualifying prior reference verified; not a proof of novelty.

results.references: - Panagiotis Patrinos, Lorenzo Stella, Alberto Bemporad. [Douglas-Rachford Splitting: Complexity Estimates and Accelerated Variants](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1407.6723v2). 2014 (CDC publication; September 2014 preprint v2 used). Complexity: $O(1+R\sqrt{(1+\gamma L)/(\gamma(1-\gamma L)\varepsilon)})$ exact proximal-oracle calls using fast Douglas–Rachford, counting both proximal evaluations per iteration, for objective gap $\le\varepsilon$; $0<\gamma L<1$.

problem_class.label: convex
problem_class.details: Minimize f(x)+g(x) over convex C in a real Hilbert space. The function f is differentiable and globally convex; g is convex on C. A constrained minimizer exists.

problem_class.label: composite
problem_class.details: The objective combines a globally L-smooth convex function f with a possibly nonsmooth convex term g restricted to C.

oracle.label: proximal
oracle.details: Exact proximal minimizers at the fixed public parameter γ: proxF minimizes f(x)+‖x−w‖²/(2γ) over E; proxG minimizes g(y)+‖y−v‖²/(2γ) over C and returns a feasible point. Exactness holds for every call index and seed. No direct gradient or function-value queries are supplied.

distinctive_assumptions.label: unknown_smoothness
distinctive_assumptions.details: L is hidden from the algorithm, while γ and λ are public and certify L≤λ/(4γ). Valid parameters satisfy L,γ,R,ε>0 and 0<λ≤1. R and ε are also hidden; the execution budget may depend on them.
distinctive_assumptions.evidence: LongTails/Setups/DouglasRachfordSmoothConvex.lean: Public; Params; spec.publicInput; spec.valid. LongTails/Template.lean: Convergence.

distinctive_assumptions.label: other
distinctive_assumptions.details: Initialization is bounded relative to a shifted minimizer: for some constrained minimizer x*, ‖w1−(x*+γ∇f(x*))‖≤R. E may be infinite-dimensional. Closedness of C and lower semicontinuity of g are not explicitly required; exact proximal minimizers must exist for every query.

accuracy.label: objective_gap
accuracy.details: The returned point satisfies f(output)+g(output)−f(x*)−g(x*)≤ε for a constrained minimizer x*. No averaging or particular iterate is prescribed.

accuracy.label: feasibility
accuracy.details: The returned point belongs to C.

accuracy.label: almost_sure
accuracy.details: Feasibility and the ε objective-gap bound hold almost surely under the joint algorithm and oracle seed law, within a fixed worst-case oracle budget.

setup_category.label: classical
setup_category.reason: This is standard smooth composite convex minimization with exact proximal access in Hilbert space, a shifted-solution initialization bound, and a feasible objective-gap target.
